metadata.description: Hand-written Agent Skills for Claude that are worth reusing.

plugins.name: skill-writing
plugins.description: How to write a skill so it carries the thinking that produced a good result rather than the residue of the session it came from.

plugins.name: chrome-walkthrough
plugins.description: Teach someone to do a task in a web app with a guided, auto-advancing walkthrough overlaid on the live page in Chrome.

plugins.name: human-handoff
plugins.description: Make settled thinking land with people: when work made in a conversation is about to go out, read it as a first-time reader would and fix reading order, load, sentences and visuals, handing back finished work.

plugins.name: north-star
plugins.description: Set the standard for what good looks like from a one-line situation, before the material can shape it, then use it as the target when producing and the yardstick when reviewing, so omissions surface alongside flaws.

plugins.name: clean-final-pass
plugins.description: Produce a final artifact from a chat full of context without carrying the conversation's residue: write it fresh from a purpose-led brief of what was decided, then check it for fidelity in both directions.
